senses.def: The real-person fiction ship of Park Ji-min and Jeon Jung-kook of the K-pop boy band BTS.
ex: "JiKook," the pairing of Korean boy band BTS members Jeon Jeong-guk and Park Ji-min, is the fourth most popular ship despite the fact that neither pairing is together in real life.
